## ReminderScheduler

ReminderScheduler sends a due-soon message two days before the due date and an
overdue message the morning after it.

## Digest

A member with several loans due on the same day receives one digest message
rather than one message per item.

## Opting out

Reminders can be switched off per member; overdue notices about fines are
always sent.
